|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on any T-47. Target a character or vehicle for free. Draw Destiny. Character hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. Vehicle hit if destiny +X > defense value, where X = pilot's ability (maximum 5).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dual Laser Cannon (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on your T-47. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Character hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. Vehicle hit if destiny +X > defense value, where X = T-47 pilot’s ability (maximum 5).” '''What changed:''' “any” → “your”; “Target” → “May target”; “Destiny.” → “destiny.”; “pilot's” → “T-47 pilot’s”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 5. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Dual Laser Cannon]].
* Later text: [[Dual Laser Cannon (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Dual Laser Cannon (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Dual Laser Cannon]].
